subject: Decision reports and the rest of Pro
preheader: PDF export, BRRRR, 10-year projections, deal compare.
headline: You're underwriting deals — here's what Pro adds when one gets serious.
body: You've been running deals on TrueCap — nice. When a deal gets real, Pro is what turns the analysis into something you can act on and share.

It adds PDF decision reports, the BRRRR and fix-and-flip analyzers, 10-year projections, illustrative tax impact and modeled exit comparisons, the sensitivity grid and Offer Ceiling solver, editing and unlimited saved deals with side-by-side compare — plus every deal checked against your Buy Box so selected-rule fit uses your criteria. The Offer Ceiling is a modeled boundary, not a recommended offer; verify every material assumption before acting.
Free saves up to 5 deals. Pro adds editing and unlimited saves and is billed as shown on the pricing page. Review the current price, trial eligibility, and cancellation terms there before upgrading.
